requirements.statement: Someone who has just installed the app can see what is still missing before a lookup will work, and reach the screen that fixes it.
requirements.title: Setup is visible and reachable

requirements.statement: A dictionary is added from inside the app, over the network, without a computer.
requirements.title: Dictionaries install themselves

requirements.statement: A build that takes minutes shows what it is doing and can be stopped.
requirements.title: A long build is legible

requirements.statement: Every word on screen is a target of its own, and the picture under the boxes is the screen as it was when the lookup started.
requirements.title: Word targets sit on a still picture

requirements.statement: A tapped word is answered with its dictionary entry: the lemma it belongs to, what form the tapped spelling is, and every sense with its marks and examples.
requirements.title: An entry, not a translation

requirements.statement: A word with no entry says so, and says whether that is because the word is missing or because no dictionary for its language is installed.
requirements.title: Missing word and missing dictionary are different answers

requirements.statement: The language a dictionary is wanted for is reached by typing its name, not by scrolling every language the phone can name.
requirements.title: The language is found by typing

states.statement: Fresh install: nothing is permitted and no dictionary exists.
states.title: Nothing set up

states.statement: Permissions are granted, but no language has been added yet, so lookups fall back to machine translation.
states.title: No dictionaries

states.statement: Set up, with dictionaries installed and their sizes shown.
states.title: Ready

states.statement: A dictionary is downloading and being built, with progress and a way to stop.
states.title: Building a dictionary

states.statement: The build stopped: no dump for that language, or the network failed.
states.title: Build failed

states.statement: The word is in the dictionary, in more than one reading, the fitting one first.
states.title: Entry found

states.statement: The dictionary is installed but has no entry for this word; a machine translation is offered as the guess it is.
states.title: No entry

states.statement: No dictionary for the language on screen is installed at all, which is a thing the reader can fix.
states.title: No dictionary installed

states.statement: The frozen screen with a box around every word that was read.
states.title: Words found

states.statement: Nothing typed yet: every language the phone can name, alphabetically.
states.title: Every language

states.statement: A few letters typed, leaving the languages whose name answers them.
states.title: Searched

views.statement: The app's own screen: what is still to be allowed, which dictionaries are on the phone, and how to add one.
views.title: Home

views.statement: The layer over another app: the screen as it was, with every word a target.
views.title: Word layer

views.statement: What a tapped word turns into: its entry, or an honest account of why there is none.
views.title: Entry card

views.statement: The list of languages a dictionary can be built for, with the search that reaches one.
views.title: Language picker
